visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman and a young boy sit together on a train; she smiles warmly and embraces him while they look out the window. (2) Indoors, a young man carefully uses a tool on the woman's face while she keeps her eyes closed in a calm setting. (3) The woman leans against a wooden closet door, speaking naturally with a gentle smile toward someone off-camera. (4) Close-up shot outdoors, the woman laughs heartily, showing visible smile lines and natural facial expressions. (5) Macro shot of the woman's scalp, revealing prominent silver-grey hair roots contrasting against her darker hair. (6) The woman sits alone in a dimly lit room, looking off-camera with a pensive, slightly sad and reflective expression. (7) A young man stands behind the woman, gently massaging her shoulders as she sits in a chair and smiles up at him. (8) The woman stands in a large hall filled with glowing, colorful hanging lanterns, smiling brightly at the camera. (9) The man and woman embrace and laugh joyfully in a bright domestic living room setting. (10) At a restaurant table, the woman holds a pink bouquet of flowers next to a large white Samoyed dog. (11) A grainy vintage photo of the woman and a young boy at a subway platform is shown briefly. (12) The man hugs the woman tightly from behind in a well-lit room; both wear matching white shirts. (13) Both individuals hold orange and brown tubes of hair product toward the camera, smiling broadly with direct eye contact. (14) Fingers part the woman's hair to display grey roots while informative text overlays appear on screen. (15) Dark brown hair dye cream is applied to the woman's temple and grey roots using gloved hands. (16) Two product tubes stand vertically on a neutral-colored surface next to their original packaging. (17) A vertical split-screen displays "Before" (showing grey roots) and "After" (showing dark brown, smooth hair). (18) The man squeezes dark, thick cream from a tube onto a clear plastic gloved hand. (19) Hands massage the dye into the woman's wet hair thoroughly in a close-up shot. (20) The woman showcases her newly dyed, voluminous dark brown hair from a side profile, looking vibrant and confident. (21) The pair shares a laugh, leaning toward each other while the man points at the woman's hair and they hold the product.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Soft, sentimental acoustic piano music plays at a moderate tempo. A young male voice narrates with a calm, nostalgic, and gentle tone, exhibiting moderate pitch and high articulation clarity. (2) A subtle whoosh transition sound effect marks a shift in visual montage. The piano melody continues with a tender, rhythmic feel. (3) As the product is showcased, a bright 'ding' sound effect triggers. The male narrator's voice becomes more energetic and promotional, with a slightly faster speech rate and higher emotional arousal. (4) Faint laughter from a female voice is heard in the background. A light 'pop' sound effect occurs during a close-up of the hair dye application. (5) Both the male and female voices laugh joyfully together toward the end. The music reaches a warm, major-key resolution, maintaining a positive and encouraging acoustic atmosphere.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Nostalgia -> Problem/Insight -> Solution -> Evidence -> Result -> Closing
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote '50 Megumi' (50惠) hair dye by tapping into the emotional bond between a son and his aging mother. It uses nostalgia and the physical sign of aging (grey hair) to introduce the product as a safe, easy-to-use solution that restores youthfulness and confidence, encouraging viewers to care for their parents' appearance and self-esteem.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of the product, detailed explanation of ingredients/usage, and a before/after comparison with a brand logo present.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively combines high-production value montage with intimate, low-inference shots of hair roots to build trust and emotional resonance with the audience.
